notes: All native reports and their exact source SHA were checked and hashed. Archive digests are GitHub metadata, not independently verified download hashes.
Twenty parameterized seeded process-crash cases and six real-file readiness cases pass on each OS; missing checkpoint tree and one separate Windows replica caller remain failures.
W3 official MCP admission framing no longer blocks discovery/initialize. Current RF3 failures include assertion/catalog and admin regressions plus one native node restart.
Counts qualify only this exact source. They do not qualify later source fixes, coverage, activation movement, power-loss durability, endurance or production readiness.
